## Claims

1. _handle_ai_fix_choice returns (True, fixed) instead of always True
2. _handle_manual_fix_choice returns (continue, fixed) tuples for fixed/skip/quit paths
3. _process_interactive_error dispatches to tuple-returning handlers; wraps quit/skip inline
4. _process_non_interactive_error now returns bool (was implicit None)
5. _process_all_errors unpacks (should_continue, fixed) and increments success_count
6. process_errors exits 0 when success_count == total_processed, 1 otherwise
7. No existing tests were modified or deleted during this change.
8. _handle_manual_fix_choice returns (True, True) for fixed path — test asserts this
9. _handle_manual_fix_choice returns (False, False) for quit path — test asserts this
10. _handle_manual_fix_choice returns (True, False) for skip path — new test added
11. _handle_ai_fix_choice returns (True, True) on success and (True, False) on failure
12. _process_interactive_error returns (False, False) for quit and (True, False) for skip
13. _process_all_errors increments success_count to 3 when all 3 non-interactive errors succeed
14. _process_all_errors leaves success_count at 0 when all non-interactive errors fail
15. _process_all_errors breaks loop on (False, False) interactive return with total_processed==0
